name: sqd-portal-mcp
description: Read validated onchain data through SQD Portal from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Read validated onchain data from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the hosted SQD Portal MCP server for read-only blockchain data. Discover networks, resolve tokens and contracts, inspect wallet or contract activity, and run analytics across EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Substrate, and Hyperliquid data.
defaultPrompt: List Base and Ethereum networks in SQD Portal.
Resolve SQD on Base and return query filters.
Summarize a wallet's recent onchain activity.
